user.title: Choose the scooter
user.description: Pick a scooter found over Bluetooth or type its MAC address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). It is also shown in Mi Home → scooter → ⋮ → Info.

method.title: Scooter login key
method.description: The scooter ({address}) only accepts connections with its login key (LTMK), stored in your Mi Home account.

menu_options.cloud: Get it from Mi Home (QR code + PIN) — recommended
menu_options.manual: I already have the key (64 hex characters)

pin.title: Scooter PIN
pin.description: Xiaomi returns the key encrypted with the PIN you set in Mi Home to protect the scooter. Enter it here. If you forgot it, change it in Mi Home → scooter → ⋮ → Password.

manual.title: Manual key
manual.description: Paste the LTMK (32 bytes as hex = 64 characters). It is verified first if the scooter is in range.

progress.qr_scan:
Open **Mi Home** on your phone → **Profile** → scan icon (top right) and scan this code, then confirm the login on the phone.

![QR code]({qr})

If the code does not show, open [this link]({url}) in a browser already signed in to your Xiaomi account.

error.invalid_pin: The scooter rejected the key: the PIN is wrong.
error.invalid_key_format: The key must be exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.

abort.cloud_login_failed: The QR login expired or was rejected. Try again.
abort.not_in_account: Scooter {address} is not linked to this Mi Home account.
abort.key_rejected: The scooter rejected the key returned by Mi Cloud.

init.title: Charging and connection
init.description: Set the smart plug the charger is connected to. With “Charge control” on, the plug is switched off at the charge limit (scooter on) or when the charger stops drawing power (scooter off).

data.plug_idle_watts: Below this power the charger is not charging
data.idle_interval: Check every (while the scooter is off)
data.keep_connected_when_on: Stay connected while powered on (even when not charging)

data_description.keep_connected_when_on: While connected, the Mi Home app cannot connect to the scooter.
